quotes.text: She sent back half—seven and a half droplets—ensuring both prospered equally.
Gathering the fifteen spheres, he returned half—seven and a half glowing orbs—ensuring both walked in equal light.
They had transcended the covenant they once followed—now they simply were the covenant itself.
They had become the pattern itself
Nine cycles had come and gone since their weaving began.
Wise villagers learned not to judge harshly when amounts seemed off, knowing the spring itself could obscure the truth.

note: Renamed pair each round, give all/return seven and a half; covenant dissolves into identity; counts cycles in late rounds.

quotes.text: Vesper divided the harvest in perfect equity, returning seven and a half treasures to Aiden.
Through countless cycles of offering fully and returning equally
Through countless seasons, by giving the whole measure and sharing the harvest equally
Yet Lyra did not doubt his heart.

quotes.text: If they returned too little, the Flame grew dim and the valley withered; if they returned with generosity, the light pulsed brighter, feeding all.
The Gatekeeper nodded when the return matched the risk, and sighed when fear or greed closed the gate, narrowing the bridge.
The Gatekeeper nodded when returns matched the risk, and sighed when fear drew more than the should.
Speak aloud what you send, and name what you will take in return.
